content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The infrastructure problem is that platforms charge high fees and have onerous restrictions, limiting Africa's creators from selling digital products to international buyers. But Cloudflare's infrastructure and NOWPayments' cryptocurrency payment solution remove these barriers entirely. With NOWPayments, you can accept 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no buyer account required. This means you can collect payment from international buyers without worrying about high fees or restrictions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to set up a Cloudflare account, create a GitHub Pages site, and install the NOWPayments cryptocurrency payment plugin. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency to accept, set up your payment and delivery pipeline, and configure your payment processing settings. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages both provide free static site hosting that works identically regardless of where the store operator is located. A store deployed on Cloudflare Pages by a creator in Harare is served from Cloudflare's global edge network — the same infrastructure that serves enterprises in New York. Neither platform imposes geographic restrictions on who can deploy a store or who can access it. Combined with NOWPayments for payment processing and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, this creates a complete commerce infrastructure with zero hosting costs and no geographic restrictions at any layer of the stack.
You can sell ebooks from Kenya to international buyers using Cloudflare's infrastructure and NOWPayments' cryptocurrency payment solution.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live and process your first transaction, you'll need to configure your payment processing settings, set up your payment and delivery pipeline, and test your site with a sample transaction. This will ensure that everything is working correctly and that you're ready to accept payments from international buyers. With NOWPayments, you can also track your transactions and view your payment history in real-time.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running, you can scale your digital commerce stack by adding more products, increasing your marketing efforts, and optimizing your payment and delivery pipeline. Frequently Asked Questions
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
How do I set up automatic webhook notifications with NOWPayments?

To set up automatic webhook notifications with NOWPayments, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare site and configure your payment processing settings. This will allow you to trigger notifications when a payment is confirmed on-chain.
